notes.title: Mark Hamill To Host ‘Thunderful World’ Digital Showcase on November 10th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37569367/892bc383a39eb0b46c5b4b09af85c4f9f1be9298.jpg[/img]

Hey friends,

we have some awesome news, which we can finally share with you today: We - that's Thunderful Games - welcome all of you to the premiere of our very first digital games showcase ‘[b]Thunderful World[/b]’! ːsteamhappyː

Find out more in the following press release:


[i][b]Gothenburg, Sweden - October 28th, 2021[/b] - International developer and publisher Thunderful Games, creator of the multi-award winning and multi-million selling SteamWorld franchise, is welcoming everyone to a new digital games showcase, ‘[b]Thunderful World[/b]’. The event will be taking place on [b]November 10th at 11am PT / 2pm ET / 7pm GMT / 8pm CET[/b], hosted by Hollywood and pop culture icon [b]Mark Hamill[/b]. Tune in to the livestream on Twitch, YouTube and the [url=https://thunderful.world/][b]thunderful.world[/b][/url] website.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37569367/8a01bc9ec10d1ba6e674354314fd34accd1fbb51.png[/img]

Tune in to see Mark delight us with a ton of exciting new game reveals and announcements from Thunderful. The event will deliver updates on exciting upcoming titles including the surprise indie hit of Summer Game Fest, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1608230/Planet_of_Lana/][b]Planet of Lana[/b][/url]. There will also be more news on Thunderful titles like [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1608550/Firegirl_Hack_n_Splash_Rescue/][b]Firegirl[/b][/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1726120/Cursed_to_Golf/][b]Cursed to Golf[/b][/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1315610/Source_of_Madness/][b]Source of Madness[/b][/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1276660/Tinkertown/][b]Tinkertown[/b][/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1158890/White_Shadows/][b]White Shadows[/b][/url]. 

Alongside Mark’s headline hosting role, the event will also feature appearances from Thunderful Group CEO Brjánn Sigurgeirsson, Corporate Vice President at Xbox Sarah Bond, plus a few other surprise industry partners.

Thunderful is proud to be partnering with Xbox and The MIX for Thunderful World. To sign up for the event and be the first to know all the important information ahead of the show on [b]November 10th[/b], head over to [url=https://thunderful.world/][b]thunderful.world[/b][/url]. As your one stop shop for all things Thunderful World, the website will be updated with new announcements and reveals as the event unfolds.[/i]


Stay tuned and tune in on Nov 10th - see you all in the event!
Your Thunderful Games-Team

notes.title: Deal with the Devil: TinyShot is Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38597595/1a8ae73237ebfdcdc8fdcc055e78ea3a3b3ec9f1.jpg[/img]

Hey folks,

The time has finally come: Get into Tiny's shoes, grab your arsenal and deal with the devil!

[b]TinyShot[/b] is OUT NOW! It is my first game ever, and I am unbelievably happy right now! But also very nervous of course, because I am really curious how you will like [b]TinyShot[/b]. I had a hell of a time developing it and I hope you have as much fun playing it! 

Overall, the creation of [b]TinyShot[/b] and releasing an actual game is the most motivating and interesting thing I've done. So, please let me know your feedback - either here in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1278760][b]Steam Community[/b][/url] or on my [url=https://discord.gg/5r3Jx2G][b]Discord channel[/b][/url].

Thanks for your feedback so far and for being part of my journey! ❤️

All the best and stay healthy!
Allaith “ZAX” Hammed

notes.title: TinyShot will be available on February 19th!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38597595/2891675c38db93215f3bd4e72ab786d846c368f2.jpg[/img]

Hey folks,

Good news: Finally [b]TinyShot[/b] has a release date! I will launch it here on Steam on February 19th! And you won't believe how happy I am!

I grew up in Syria, but fortunately my family was able to move to the Netherlands. I had some tough times and my way of dealing with them was sitting in my room and creating something rather than going outside. Because I really liked The Binding of Isaac & Super Meat Boy back when they came out, I took inspiration from both of them, and the result was a prototype at the indie expo - and it's been a fun journey ever since.

As for my age, I started working on Tinyshot when I was 17 and now I'm 19. Overall the creation of [b]TinyShot[/b] and releasing an actual game is the most motivating and interesting thing I've done. 10 yr old me would probably be amazed. ːsteamhappyː

And if you should ask yourself what exactly [b]TinyShot[/b] is, get a glimpse here from one of the cheapest trailers ever made:

[previewyoutube=Lw67JZXsSOk;full][/previewyoutube]
All the best and stay healthy!
Allaith “ZAX” Hammed

notes.title: The MIX Next: Watch the Show and play our TinyShot Demo!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38597595/9344ad55e3417c94621465926b2ea43b8a17ac48.jpg[/img]

Hey folks,

[b]The MIX Next[/b] event will take place very soon (only online of course) - and I am really happy to announce that [b]TinyShot[/b] is a part of it! There will be new footage in the show - commented by us. So, you should definitely take a look on [b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/mediaindieexchange]Twitch[/url][/b] or the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/theMIX]Steam feature page[/url][/b]!

Celebrating [b]The MIX Next[/b] there is also a demo available for the upcoming days! Take your first steps in the shoes of Tiny and get equipped with guns and melee weapons to help you conquer the waves of enemies! Move smoothly around the environment and make sure to use your dash abilities because dodging enemies is as important as blasting them!

We hope you enjoy it! If you have any questions or feedback please drop everything on our [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/SqgRMRB]Discord channel[/url][/b] or the [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1278760]Steam community[/url][/b] here!

Oh, and don't forget to tell your friends and add [b]TinyShot[/b] on your Wishlist! ːsteamhappyː

All the best and stay healthy!
Allaith “ZAX”

notes.title: PAX Online: Play the TinyShot Demo till September 20th!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38597595/3f55243e9b83db7bbb112885623be228c2c9712a.jpg[/img]

Hey folks!
[b]
PAX Online[/b] just started - and this means the start of nine days full of awesome games! And of course [b]TinyShot[/b] can't miss out on that!

That's why it’s demo time! Take your first steps in the shoes of Tiny and get equipped with guns and melee weapons to help you conquer the waves of enemies! Move smoothly around the environment and make sure to use your dash abilities because dodging enemies is as important as blasting them!

But don't wait to long, the demo will only be available for the time of [b]PAX Online[/b] - from [b]September 12th till September 20th[/b]! I hope you enjoy the beginning of Tinys journey. If you have any questions or feedback please drop everything on my [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/SqgRMRB]Discord channel[/url][/b] or the [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1278760]Steam Community[/url][/b] here!

Oh, and don't forget to get [b]TinyShot[/b] on your Wishlist! ːsteamhappyː
